source_summary: Chinese landscape painting with layered misty mountains, pine-dotted cliffs, cloud banks, wooded rocky promontories, and a small boat with figures on open water; calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: central_towering_peak
motifs.description: Isolate the dominant central mountain mass: a tall rounded peak with stacked cliff faces, winding ledges, pine clusters, and pale ink-wash modeling. Exclude the calligraphy above/right and the separate foreground trees below.
must_preserve: soft contour linework defining layered rock faces
vertical and diagonal wash texture on the cliffs
small dark pine-needle clusters along ridges and ledges
mist-softened lower edge where the mountain dissolves into cloud

motifs.name: left_misty_mountain_chain
motifs.description: Isolate the receding left-side mountain chain with tall vapor-softened peaks, lower ridges, and scattered pine dots on the slopes. Include the pale silhouettes and darker foreground ridges, but exclude seals on the far left margin.
must_preserve: faint ink washes forming distant vertical peaks
thin contour strokes on nearer ridges
soft mist gaps between overlapping mountains

motifs.name: right_receding_cliffs
motifs.description: Isolate the right-side background and midground cliffs: distant blocky peak silhouettes, rounded ridges, pine-dotted slopes, and pale valley forms. Exclude nearby calligraphy and red seals.
must_preserve: small dark pine marks on crests
delicate ink outlines of overlapping cliff planes

motifs.name: central_cloud_sea
motifs.description: Isolate the broad horizontal belt of mist and cloud forms across the middle of the painting, including scalloped vapor edges and layered pale washes around the mountain bases. Do not include solid cliffs or tree groups except where cloud contours pass in front of them.
must_preserve: gaps where mountains appear partially veiled

motifs.name: midground_tree_promontory
motifs.description: Isolate the central rocky promontory with clustered trees: bare-branched deciduous trees, dark dense foliage, red-leaf accents, pale green shrubs, exposed roots, and layered rocks at the base. Exclude the surrounding cloud bank and distant mountains as much as possible.
must_preserve: layered rock contours and root-like strokes

motifs.name: right_foreground_slope
motifs.description: Isolate the sweeping right-side rocky hillside descending toward the center, with rounded cliff shelves, sparse pine clusters, boulders, and pale contour washes. Exclude the central tree promontory and distant mountain peaks.
must_preserve: small dark pine-needle clusters along ridge edges
rounded boulder outlines near the lower slope

motifs.name: river_boat_figures
motifs.description: Isolate the small boat on the open water with seated scholar-like figures and a rower. Include the slender hull, oar, passengers, and faint water wash immediately around the boat, but exclude shore trees and seals.
must_preserve: tiny seated figure silhouettes and robes
subtle ink accents inside the boat
faint surrounding water wash without paper texture

motifs.name: lower_left_riverbank_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left foreground riverbank with sloping rocks, a grove of bare-branched and leafy trees, red blossom accents, dark foliage clumps, and layered shore stones. Exclude the red seals along the far left margin and the boat above.
must_preserve: red leaf or blossom accents on upper branches
layered rock and shoreline contour strokes
small pine-dot textures along the slope

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
